review_candidates.description: Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Sistemas TI para incorporarse al equipo interno de tecnología. La persona seleccionada participará de forma activa en la operación, evolución y mejora de la infraestructura y los servicios TI de la organización, con implicación directa en proyectos de distinta naturaleza tecnológica. Buscamos un profesional con una base técnica sólida, con criterio para elegir la solución más adecuada en cada contexto y capacidad real de adaptarse a áreas tecnológicas diversas: sistemas, virtualización, cloud, redes, automatización, seguridad u otras que vayan surgiendo con la evolución del entorno. 🔵◼️ Requerimientos: A nivel formativo: Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones o equivalente, o Ciclo Formativo de Grado Superior en el área de sistemas o redes con experiencia acreditada. Experiencia: Se requiere experiencia práctica en varias de las siguientes áreas, valorándose la amplitud de base y disposición a seguir aprendiendo: Sistemas operativos de servidor: administración en entornos Windows y/o Linux. Virtualización e infraestructura: administración de plataformas de virtualización de servidores y gestión de recursos computacionales. Contenedores y orquestación: conocimiento y experiencia con tecnologías de empaquetado y despliegue de aplicaciones en contenedores. Cloud y servicios corporativos: experiencia con al menos un entorno cloud (pública, privada o híbrida) y administración de servicios de colaboración empresarial. Automatización: scripting y uso de herramientas de gestión de configuración o infraestructura como código para reducir trabajo manual y aumentar la repetibilidad. Redes: conocimientos sólidos de redes TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP y conectividad corporativa. Administración herramientas ITSM: experiencia con Service-Now. 🔵◼️ Requerimientos adicionales: Experiencia o interés en herramientas de inteligencia artificial aplicada a operaciones TI. Conocimientos de ciberseguridad aplicada a infraestructura: hardening, gestión de vulnerabilidades, monitorización. Familiaridad con metodologías y prácticas DevOps o cultura de mejora continua. Experiencia en gestión de sistemas de almacenamiento y soluciones de backup empresarial. Certificaciones técnicas en cualquier área relevante (sistemas, cloud, redes, seguridad…). 🔵◼️ Qué ofrecemos: Contrato indefinido y un proyecto estable. Jornada completa y trabajo híbrido (40% presencial / 60%remoto) en nuestra sede de Aravaca, situada en Avenida de Europa, 34, Madrid. Horario de invierno de 9h a 18:30h de lunes a jueves y viernes de 8h a 14h (con margen de flexibilidad). Durante el verano, coincidiendo con el calendario escolar, hacemos jornada intensiva de 8h a 15h de lunes a viernes. Un puesto polivalente y con contacto habitual con diferentes áreas, profesionales, clientes y proveedores. 🔵◼️ ¿Quiénes somos? Somos SATEC, una compañía con más de 30 años de experiencia ayudando a organizaciones públicas y privadas a transformar su modelo de negocio mediante la tecnología. Diseñamos, integramos y operamos soluciones orientadas a la innovación, la eficiencia, la seguridad y la continuidad del negocio. Con presencia en España, Marruecos y Arabia Saudí, desarrollamos soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades de cada cliente en ámbitos como ciberseguridad, networking, infraestructura, data, inteligencia artificial, cloud, BOSS y servicios gestionados. En el Grupo SATEC, la diversidad es una seña de identidad. Promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades y la equidad, creando un entorno inclusivo en el que todas las personas puedan desarrollar su potencial.

review_candidates.description: About CLS: CLS is the trusted party at the centre of the global FX ecosystem. Utilized by thousands of counterparties, CLS makes FX safer, smoother and more cost effective. Trillions of dollars’ worth of currency flows through our systems each day. Created by the market for the market, our unrivalled global settlement infrastructure reduces systemic risk and provides standardization for participants in many of the world’s most actively traded currencies. We deliver huge efficiencies and savings for our clients: in fact, our approach to multilateral netting shrinks funding requirements by over 96% on average, so clients can put their capital and resources to better use. CLS products are designed to enable clients to manage risk most effectively across the full FX lifecycle – whether through more efficient processing tools or market intelligence derived from the largest single source of FX executed data available to the market. Our ambition to make a positive difference starts with our people. Our values – Protect, Improve, Grow – underpin everything that we do at CLS and define and shape a supportive and inclusive working environment in which everyone is encouraged to be open and forward-thinking Job Information: Functional Title: End User Support Specialist Department: Digital Workspace Corporate Level: Senior Associate Reports To: Vice President, Infrastructure End User Support Location: London, on-site 5 days per week A Senior Associate role for an Infrastructure End User Support Specialist who can lead escalations, mentor colleagues, support modern endpoint management, and help launch our new Technology Bar. Overview of the role: CLS is modernizing the way technology is delivered to colleagues. We are moving further into a Windows 11 and Microsoft Intune managed estate, reducing reliance on legacy endpoint tooling, and opening a new Technology Bar in our refurbished London office. We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Desktop Support Engineer to become the senior technical member of our London End User Computing team. This is more than a traditional desktop role: you will be the person the team turns to for complex escalations, practical judgement, coaching, technical standards and service improvement. The role combines hands-on support, endpoint engineering, technical leadership, hardware service capability and project contribution. It is ideal for someone who wants to influence how an End User Computing function operates rather than simply work through a ticket queue. What you will be doing: How you will spend your time Desktop Support - 45% - Senior escalations point for Windows 11, Microsoft 365 collaboration technologies, meeting rooms, executive support and complex incidents. Endpoint Engineering - 25% - Intune, Autopilot, application development, endpoint compliance, hardware standards and device lifecycle management. Technology Leadership - 20% - Mentoring engineers, leading investigations, improving documentation, setting standards and acting as the senior technical voice of the team. Continuous improvements & innovation - 10% - Technology Bar development, automation of processes, Windows 11 rollout support, process optimization and measurable service improvements. What we are looking for: We are not looking for someone who only resolves individual tickets. We are looking for someone who asks why the issue happened, whether it will happen again, how the team can prevent it, and what can be improved so the next user has a better experience. Key Technologies include: Windows 11 Microsoft Intune / Windows Autopilot Hardware vendor warranty tooling Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft 365 Exchange Online Microsoft Teams OneDrive Endpoint Security Active Directory ServiceNow PowerShell Secondary / legacy technologies SCCM - Supporting the transition to Intune Citrix - Supporting the virtualized environment Group Policy - Hybrid estate support Our commitment to employees: We are a small company with a big mandate, so every person is essential to our success. We are also committed to employing and retaining the most talented and dedicated people. What makes us interesting goes beyond our competitive salaries and great benefits. Our work environment is designed around quality outcomes, not output. The FX market would cease to function without our services, and we take pride in being responsible for keeping it running smoothly. We are different from other financial institutions in that we have a flatter and more transparent structure with accessible leadership. You will be seen, heard and empowered to develop your career. We are a purpose-driven organization, with an inclusive culture that focuses on doing what is right. The well-being of our people is as important to us as the resilience of our systems. In addition to encouraging our people to ‘locate for their day,’ we run a range of initiatives that support employees’ sense of belonging and physical, emotional and mental well-being. Our extensive benefits for employees typically include: Vacation/annual leave: 25 days in UK/Asia + 3 life days, 23 in US + 3 life days Private medical and dental cover and life insurance Generous pension contributions in the UK and Asia; matching 401(k) in the US Paid volunteer days ‘Locate for your day’ hybrid working – 2 days a week in office. Access to Discover – our learning platform with 1000+ courses from LinkedIn Learning. Paid parental leave / Coaching and support services Career development / LinkedIn Learning ‘Heads down days’ with no meetings on the last Friday of every month Wellbeing / Mental health support Diversity Council / Affinity groups (Women’s Forum, Black Employee Network, Pride Network, Parents & Caregivers Network, Sustainability Network) Social events Awards: The Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2023 & 2024 / Big Company / The Sunday Times Awards Third place in Britain’s Healthiest Workplace 2022 / Medium Company / Vitality Awards

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM Location : Greater Sao Paulo, Brazil Role Overview We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1) to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments . This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2. Key Responsibilities Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior . Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related . Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools . Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts . Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis . Exposure to cloud environments; AWS basics preferred . Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations . Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required . Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination. Preferred Qualifications Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management . Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory. Soft Skills Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability. About Acceleronix Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market. With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0. Life at Acceleronix LATAM At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... This team is dedicated to ensuring that all employees have the necessary tools and resources to perform their roles efficiently. In essence, IT Operations ensures the availability, reliability and security of the systems that support the business day to day operations. In this role, you'll; Own IT operations across multiple countries, ensuring 99.9% uptime for IT services, hardware, and core tools at all locations. Act as the primary escalation point for country-level IT issues, coordinating with local IT staff and external vendors to resolve problems quickly. Ensure all employees across your region have access to the tools and equipment they need to perform their roles effectively. Develop and maintain playbooks, policies, and documentation to align how IT staff work, regardless of location, and guide employees on equipment and tools used at Wave. Ensure adherence to standardized IT processes and policies across your countries of oversight, such as onboarding, offboarding, infrastructure configuration and management, asset management, information security, etc. Partner with the Information Security team to implement and uphold Wave's security policies, adapting them to the operational realities of each country in your region. Advise the broader IT and leadership teams on regional nuances — including purchasing constraints, network infrastructure, and local regulations — that affect how Wave policies are designed and executed. Identify and flag resourcing gaps, drive hiring decisions for IT roles within your remit. Collaborate cross-functionally with People, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure IT supports Wave's broader business goals. Review contracts, service level agreements (SLAs), renewals, and vendor performance metrics. Evaluate technology investments and provide cost-benefit recommendations to leadership. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce risk. Participate in security reviews, incident response discussions, and risk assessments. Support initiatives related to identity management, multi-factor authentication, endpoint security, and compliance. Exercise sound judgment when evaluating security concerns and escalation requirements. Analyze vendor reports, operational metrics, technology spending, and support trends. Own the IT Budget for your countries of remit. Key details Location: You'll be based in Wave's operating market- Côte d'Ivoire and will travel regularly across your region. Work authorization in Ivory Coast is required This is a permanent position Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula. We run performance reviews twice a year and award bonuses to strong performers who have been with the company for more than 6 months We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents We support working parents - we offer 26 weeks of parental leave for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers, in addition to subsidized child care when they return to work Airtime reimbursement Free food and a beautiful office space Requirements Fluency in both English and French 5+ years as a Country IT Manager, ideally in a fast-paced office setting Demonstrated experience managing IT operations across regionally dispersed teams or offices Experience managing and troubleshooting corporate apps like Gsuite Network management (experience with products like Palo Alto, Cisco, Sophos, etc...) Experience selecting, implementing and managing endpoint management systems (Jamf, Intune, Bigfix, SCCM), and different operating systems (macOS, windows/android, iOS) Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills Experience in telephony or telephony infrastructure management. Experience in process improvement and change management. Complex multi-stakeholder project management experience. Experience in managing information security operations You might be a good fit if you Demonstrate tenacity and a willingness to go the distance to get something done. Can formulate, document, and implement IT policies while staying updated on new policies that impact our operations. Are comfortable defaulting to over-communication and overreaching when it comes to coordination. Have the capability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders to achieve IT objectives and support business goals. Have experience managing, developing and growing IT teams. Adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions and cope effectively with complexity and change. Are excessively detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do. Have developed processes with minimal guidance and have implemented them effectively. Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue. Daarom investeren we niet alleen in onze klanten, maar juist ook in onze collega's. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Leaseauto (elektrisch met een budget van maximaal €997,-) of een mobiliteitsbudget van maximaal €817,-. 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid extra dagen bij te kopen. Mogelijkheid tot ADV sparen. Laptop van de zaak en een telefoon naar keuze ter waarde van €750,-. Winstdeelregeling. Goede pensioenregeling. Deelname aan het Castor-aandelenprogramma. Lease a Bike-regeling. Opleidingstrajecten en certificeringsmogelijkheden via onder meer de VINCI Academy. Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting Operations Engineer, Specialist of Consultant. Binnen Axians Integrated Solutions werken we aan slimme integratieoplossingen waarmee organisaties applicaties, systemen en data met elkaar verbinden. Ons Services-team zorgt ervoor dat deze oplossingen dagelijks betrouwbaar blijven draaien. De lijnen zijn kort, kennis wordt actief gedeeld en je werkt nauw samen met technische specialisten die net als jij graag complexe vraagstukken oplossen. We erkennen echter dat iedereen een eigen combinatie van skills en ervaring meebrengt. Daarnaast weten we dat veel mensen pas reageren wanneer zij denken volledig aan alle eisen te voldoen. Juist daarom moedigen we je aan om ook te solliciteren wanneer je jezelf in grote lijnen in het profiel herkent, ook als je niet aan alle voorwaarden voldoet.
